reproduction: Run the new notebook's code cells in order with the repository .venv; every numerical input is an existing CSV.

mathematics.assertion_tested: For every stored Adam fit, C = IF + EP + Taylor and fully_remainder_removed = IF; exact sample-variance decomposition; descriptive finite-sample bias and covariance analysis.
mathematics.conventions: N=n_train=0.8*n_full; epochs=1000; strict residual<0 score; full symmetric stored Sigma2; linear solves; sample SD ddof=1; user-specified Taylor normalization.
non_claims: No asymptotic convergence rate or theorem proof.
No refits or new Monte Carlo replications.
No intrinsic EP/Taylor noise separation from aggregated population-score estimates.
No resolution of the supplement's printed Taylor normalization/sign discrepancy.
